summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen, despite his retirement, had gone East and made a match with George Rooke, with $500 a side posted with Harry Hill, for a fight within fifty miles of Pittsburg on June 17.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The St. Louis Republican, Wednesday, March 17, 1875'; filed as Missouri Republican per rubric (pre-1888).

facts.fact: Allen went East to arrange a match with George Rooke, despite his announced retirement and recent denial of the match
Allen and George Rooke made a match, with $500 a side (one-sixth of the agreed stake) deposited with Harry Hill, to fight within fifty miles of Pittsburg on June 17, 1875
Allen was described as 36 years old and weighing 210 pounds, needing to train down to 172 pounds to fight

notes: 'Gone East' does not name a city; Harry Hill was a New York stakeholder, so New York is inferred (medium). Most of the article is about Rooke's 1867 fight with Rockey Moore. Current title is acceptable; suggestion follows the printed headline.
